includes: openclaw channels (every subcommand), openclaw message (every subcommand), openclaw directory and openclaw pairing: this area's CLI commands

channels.* Gateway methods (status, start, stop, logout, pairing list/approve/dismiss), web.login.start and web.login.wait (QR login for a channel account), send, poll and message.action: this area's Gateway methods
users.linkChannelIdentity, users.unlinkChannelIdentity, users.listChannelIdentities: linking a channel sender to a Gateway user is this area's operation
the Channels page of the Control UI (ui/src/pages/channels): this area's UI actions

the agent's message tool and its actions (send, reply, react, reactions, emoji-list, edit, delete, read, search, thread, poll and the rest the tool registers): entry points of kind agent call, one per action; this area's operations. There is no separate reactions tool at this revision: reactions are the message tool's actions

every bundled channel adapter listed in docs/channels/index.md with source under extensions/<id>/src is one entry point of kind channel route (its inbound monitor); its outbound side is reached through the send operations; adapter-specific features described only on that channel's own pages (docs/channels/<id>.md, docs/channels/<id>/*) are not read and not enumerated: they need that platform's real account and are recorded once per adapter in coverage.md as outside reach

telegram and discord adapters are reachable without a real account through Kova's platform shim and fixture (support/channels/telegram, support/channels/discord, support/run-channel-adapter-conformance.mjs); every other adapter's live inbound and outbound is outside reach

Kova's conformance channel (support/plugins/kova-channel-probe with Gateway methods kova.channelProbe.status, reset, inject, observations; support/run-channel-probe-turn.mjs; support/channel-conformance) drives inbound turns, DM, group and thread routing, acknowledgements, delivery, drafts and previews, reactions and media; it is the harness, not an entry point
DM, group and thread routing, mention gating, access groups, allowlists, pairing of unknown senders, broadcast groups, ambient room events and bot-loop protection: this area's

delivery: chunking, markdown formatting per channel, retry, the durable delivery queue and its recovery after a restart, typing indicators, acknowledgement and status reactions, streaming drafts, previews and progress drafts, polls, location payloads and media sent or received over channels: this area's
channel setup through openclaw channels add, login, logout, remove and the configure wizard's channel step: this area's; the plugin install that channels add may trigger is from plugins
src/plugin-sdk/channel-*.ts: the channel-facing plugin SDK the adapters call is this area's; SDK functions are not entry points

openclaw agent --deliver, cron job delivery, heartbeat delivery and subagent announce to a channel: entry points of kind from agents, from cron, from heartbeat and from subagents; the delivery operation they reach is listed, their own code is not
channels listed in docs/channels/index.md that have no source in this checkout (external plugins such as qqbot, wechat, wecom, yuanbao, zaloclawbot): listed as entry points and excluded as external
interactive callbacks (presentation buttons and selects, question choices), inbound reaction notifications and native command menu invocations: entry points of kind channel route, one each
the outbound delivery queue recovery pass, the session delivery queue recovery and the channel ingress drain poll: entry points of kind scheduled job, one each

docs/gateway/restart-recovery.md: every heading is walked; a state or event is this area's condition only where its consequence is on channel accounts, channel auto-start, inbound or delivery; the other headings are recorded `none (owned by <area>)`

docs/channels/troubleshooting.md: each failure signature row that states a channel state with its own consequence is one condition, named for its channel; a row on an adapter other than telegram or discord is recorded outside reach

a heading in a listed document whose states belong to an excluded area is recorded `none (owned by <area>)`; a state under such a heading whose consequence is on channel inbound, routing or delivery is this area's condition
files under extensions/qa-lab and extensions/qa-channel found by the search list are listed one per file and excluded as test-only
excludes: src/channels/session*.ts, chat.send, chat.* and the Control UI chat (webchat is not a channel), session.reactions.*, thread-bound subagent sessions (docs/tools/subagents/thread-bound-sessions.md): owned by sessions
release channels (stable, beta, dev), src/infra/update-channels.ts, openclaw update --channel: owned by update; 'channel' there means a release channel

installing, enabling, disabling, updating and removing channel plugins, plugin manifests and package.json files under extensions/*, docs/plugins/sdk-channel-plugins.md and docs/plugins/sdk-channel-plugins/*: owned by plugins
config read, write, patch, save, reload and schema validation mechanics: owned by config; what a channel config key does at runtime is this area's
src/channels/qa-channel and extensions/qa-channel, docs/channels/qa-channel.md: a repo-local test transport excluded from packaged installs; test-only
exec and plugin approval delivery over channels, approval reactions (src/infra/approval-*, src/plugin-sdk/approval-*): owned by approvals
device and node pairing, openclaw qr, setup and join codes (src/pairing/setup-code.ts, src/pairing/join-code.ts), devices.*, push notifications: owned by nodes
voice channels, talk and TTS (docs/nodes/talk/*, Discord voice): owned by talk

slash command parsing and execution (src/auto-reply/commands*, src/auto-reply/command*, src/auto-reply/reply/commands*): owned by commands; channel-native command menus an adapter registers are this area's

agent runs, reply generation and the run queue (src/auto-reply/reply/agent-*, src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply*, src/auto-reply/reply/queue*, src/auto-reply/reply/followup*, docs/concepts/queue.md): owned by agents
state migrations of channel data (src/infra/state-migrations.*): owned by update
Windows-only and macOS-only adapters' host requirements (imessage needs macOS): a phase that needs another platform is outside this template's reach

conversations_list, conversations_send and conversations_turn agent tools and the conversations.* Gateway methods (docs/concepts/session-tool.md): owned by sessions; files the search list finds that call them are entry points of kind from sessions
